translations.web: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
translations.bsb: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
translations.kjv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
translations.asv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling words), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.
